primary_scope: 82 main datasets. The 10 related TabReD gap versions are excluded.
primary_unit: one fold-aggregated value per model, dataset and individual method configuration
primary_outcome: relative error reduction from model-level mean errors, masked where the inductive baseline is near-perfect
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg within each specification-by-model block. Within-method q-values are also reported.
cautions: Correlations are exploratory associations and do not show which method should be selected for a new dataset.
Baseline performance is mathematically coupled to relative lift. The normalized absolute-gain sensitivity addresses this dependence.
The three models have different dataset and method coverage.
Task-specific traits use fewer datasets. Every cell reports its own n.
Test-target shift and baseline performance use test labels and are post-hoc explanatory characteristics.
The 10 related TabReD gap versions are excluded from the primary matrix to avoid pseudo-replication.
